headline: RBC Capital Maintains Outperform on Broadridge Financial, Raises Price Target to $225
summary: RBC Capital  analyst Daniel R. Perlin   maintains Broadridge Financial (NYSE:BR) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $200 to $225.
